answer: Re-run a random sample of delivered jobs. When an agent bills for a task, say surveying how much timber remains on a storm-felled slope, an auditor picked by lottery repeats the work and compares. A sybil ring that pads its record with fake jobs traded among its own clones can't survive this: the auditor finds only a bare rock ledge and a sable's den where the report claimed standing pine, and every clone that endorsed that job loses its bond. Fake volume becomes liability, not reputation.
